about_the_game:
🌊⚓ NAVY STRIKE: PINBALL COMMAND ⚓🌊
🔥 Lead your fleet to victory in this high-seas pinball showdown! 🔥

Step into the command center of a naval warzone with a stunning Navy-themed pinball table, packed with 🛳️ battleships, ✈️ aircraft carriers, and ⚙️ military-grade detail. Designed for precision and chaos, this table drops you into the heart of sea warfare with immersive visuals, interactive challenges, and explosive missions 💣.

🚢 Key Features:

  • 🎖️ Authentic Military Design
    A richly detailed naval battlefield featuring 3D warships, radar panels 🛰️, helipads 🚁, and brass-plated hardware 🛠️.

  • 🎯 Mission-Driven Gameplay
    Take command through 🥊 naval boxing showdowns, sonar puzzles 📡, and deep-sea exploration challenges 🐙.

  • 🌀 Tactical Ramps & Targets
    Strategically fire the ball across ship decks, through radar rings, and around compass-laden bumpers 🧭.

  • 🧨 Ballistic Submarine Challenge
    Dive below the surface in a high-risk underwater segment 🌊 for a chance at massive bonus multipliers 💰.

  • 🎱 Realistic Pinball Physics
    Smooth ball control, ricochet chaos 💥, and multi-ball action deliver a satisfying and responsive play.

  • 🔊 Dynamic Visuals & Sound
    High seas come alive with captain voiceovers 🎙️, sonar pings 📢, engine roars 🛞, and sea-shanty soundtracks 🎶.

  • 🎙️ "Fire up the Admiral Slots, sailor! Three of a kind gets you the jackpot—don’t let those brass hats down!"

⚔️ Ready your crew. Prime the cannons. Launch the mission. Your Navy legacy begins on the table. ⚔️

🥊 Captain’s Bet Brawl – Fight for the Points!

When the second watch begins, two towering pillars rise from the depths 🏛️—each representing a fearsome fighter. Choose wisely: Left Pillar 🥊 or Right Pillar 🥊. It’s time to place your bet!

🎥 As the crowd gathers, a screen ignites in the center of the playfield, revealing an epic battle between the chosen champions. This is Captain’s Bet Brawl, a high-stakes naval mini-game where victory pays off... and failure stings.

  • ✅ Win your bet – Earn 20,000 points and bask in the glory!

  • ❌ Lose the bet – Forfeit 20,000 points to the sea.

⚓ Do you trust your gut, sailor? Pick your fighter, brace for battle, and let fate decide in Captain’s Bet Brawl!

🎰 The Admiral Slots – Spin for Glory!

Take your shot up the center ramp and you'll activate The Admiral Slots, located right at the back of the table behind the command tower. Three stern-faced Admirals await 🧓🧓🧓—but only the lucky will match all three.

  • 🎯 Match all 3 Admirals and unlock a massive bonus jackpot!

It’s all about timing, precision, and a bit of high-seas luck. Will you impress the Admiralty or be sent back below deck?

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunge
